claims.claim: The Internet is network infrastructure, while the Web is a service built on that infrastructure.
DNS maps a hostname used in a web address to an IP address, and a browser can use cached results for later requests.
HTTP is a stateless application-level request/response protocol; an HTTP client sends a request and a server sends a response.
For a page navigation, a browser commonly fetches an initial document and then discovers and requests additional resources while parsing it.
HTTPS is HTTP sent over a TLS-encrypted connection; TLS provides encryption and authentication of the server in the usual browser-server setup.
A browser parses received resources and builds structures used to calculate layout and paint pixels; rendering is not a single download-to-screen step.

Kept markup, styling, scripting, deployment, and exploitation details for their dedicated lessons.
